corrections.text: The article states that "The Node.js notes do not mention CI." The statement refers to continuous integration on Intel macOS runners, which the Node.js 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 notes do not mention; the notes do list unrelated CI commit entries (for example "update flags for V8 CI" and "fail Windows CI on missing GYP sources").

The article contrasts the 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 note with the 26.13.0 release page still listing a "macOS Intel 64-bit Binary". The 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 release page's download list also has a "macOS Intel 64-bit Binary" entry, which reads "Coming soon" rather than a download link.
